criteria.o5: Origin: interaction/astronomy-shop/frontend--cart. Calls from deployment/frontend to deployment/cart time out; deployment/frontend retries them, and the retries add load that keeps deployment/cart saturated, so the failure sustains itself. | Together with: deployment/astronomy-shop/frontend, deployment/astronomy-shop/cart | Observed impact on: deployment/astronomy-shop/cart, deployment/astronomy-shop/frontend | Checks: errors of deployment/frontend on deployment/cart are timeouts or overload (supports)
criteria.o6: Origin: deployment/astronomy-shop/checkout. deployment/checkout's running authentication settings no longer match the credentials deployment/frontend present, so their requests are rejected although deployment/checkout itself keeps running. | Observed impact on: deployment/astronomy-shop/frontend | Checks: deployment/checkout shows no trouble of its own (supports); deployment/checkout's configuration was not changed (supports)
criteria.o7: None of these explanations fits the evidence.

instructions.question: Which explanation best accounts for all the observed symptoms in `evidence`?
how_to_decide: Prefer the explanation whose chain is supported by the observed facts and explains the most symptoms; an explanation contradicted by a fact is unlikely.
A component that only fails because something it calls fails is a victim, not the origin.
Choose `o7` when none of the explanations fits the evidence.
